auto_wake.docs:
**boolean**: Pulse `wakeup_pin` before sending a command. **Requires** `wakeup_pin`.

*See also: [LD6002B 3D Presence Radar](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld6002b#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID for this component.

*See also: [LD6002B 3D Presence Radar](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld6002b#configuration-variables)*

uart_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID of the [UART Component](https://esphome.io/components/uart) to use. Required if you have multiple UARTs configured.

*See also: [LD6002B 3D Presence Radar](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld6002b#configuration-variables)*

wakeup_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: Pin used to wake the radar from low power mode. Required if you want `auto_wake` or the `wake` button to function. With `low_power` enabled and no `wakeup_pin` wired, the first command after an idle period is consumed as a wake-up and is retried automatically; wiring `wakeup_pin` avoids that retry.

*See also: [LD6002B 3D Presence Radar](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld6002b#configuration-variables)*

wakeup_pulse.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: Pulse length for the wakeup pin. **Requires** `wakeup_pin`.

*See also: [LD6002B 3D Presence Radar](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld6002b#configuration-variables)*

ld6002b_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID of the LD6002B component.

*See also: [LD6002B 3D Presence Radar](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld6002b#configuration-variables)*

target.docs:
True if any target is detected or any detection area reports presence. All options from [Binary Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/binary_sensor#config-binary_sensor).

*See also: [LD6002B 3D Presence Radar](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld6002b#configuration-variables)*

apply_area.docs:
Send the configured `area_config` to the selected `area_id`. **Requires** a `select.area_id` on the same `ld6002b`. All options from [Button](https://esphome.io/components/button#config-button).

*See also: [LD6002B 3D Presence Radar](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld6002b#configuration-variables)*

auto_interference.docs:
Generate interference areas from the current environment. Run this with no people present and with known interference sources active. To reset the generated interference areas, use **Clear Interference**. All options from [Button](https://esphome.io/components/button#config-button).

*See also: [LD6002B 3D Presence Radar](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld6002b#configuration-variables)*

clear_interference.docs:
Clear interference areas. All options from [Button](https://esphome.io/components/button#config-button).

*See also: [LD6002B 3D Presence Radar](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld6002b#configuration-variables)*

get_areas.docs:
Request stored interference/detection areas from the radar. All options from [Button](https://esphome.io/components/button#config-button).

*See also: [LD6002B 3D Presence Radar](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld6002b#configuration-variables)*

get_delay.docs:
Request hold delay. All options from [Button](https://esphome.io/components/button#config-button).

*See also: [LD6002B 3D Presence Radar](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld6002b#configuration-variables)*

get_installation.docs:
Request installation mode from the radar and update the `installation_mode` select with `top` or `side`. All options from [Button](https://esphome.io/components/button#config-button).

*See also: [LD6002B 3D Presence Radar](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld6002b#configuration-variables)*

get_low_power_mode.docs:
Request low power mode state. All options from [Button](https://esphome.io/components/button#config-button).

*See also: [LD6002B 3D Presence Radar](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld6002b#configuration-variables)*

get_low_power_sleep_time.docs:
Request low power sleep time. All options from [Button](https://esphome.io/components/button#config-button).

*See also: [LD6002B 3D Presence Radar](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld6002b#configuration-variables)*

get_sensitivity.docs:
Request sensitivity state. All options from [Button](https://esphome.io/components/button#config-button).

*See also: [LD6002B 3D Presence Radar](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld6002b#configuration-variables)*

get_trigger_speed.docs:
Request trigger speed state. All options from [Button](https://esphome.io/components/button#config-button).

*See also: [LD6002B 3D Presence Radar](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld6002b#configuration-variables)*

get_z_range.docs:
Request Z-axis range. All options from [Button](https://esphome.io/components/button#config-button).

*See also: [LD6002B 3D Presence Radar](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld6002b#configuration-variables)*

ld6002b_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID of the LD6002B component.

*See also: [LD6002B 3D Presence Radar](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld6002b#configuration-variables)*

reset_detection_area.docs:
Reset detection areas to defaults (4 m by 4 m). All options from [Button](https://esphome.io/components/button#config-button).

*See also: [LD6002B 3D Presence Radar](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld6002b#configuration-variables)*

reset_unattended.docs:
Reset the module's unattended (no-person) state used by its low-power logic. Helpful if the device gets stuck in an unattended state. All options from [Button](https://esphome.io/components/button#config-button).

*See also: [LD6002B 3D Presence Radar](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld6002b#configuration-variables)*

wake.docs:
Pulse the `wakeup_pin` to wake the radar. **Requires** `wakeup_pin` on the parent `ld6002b`. All options from [Button](https://esphome.io/components/button#config-button).

*See also: [LD6002B 3D Presence Radar](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld6002b#configuration-variables)*

area_config.docs:
Coordinate values (`x_min`/`x_max`/`y_min`/`y_max`/`z_min`/`z_max`, each range `-10`–`10` m, step `0.1`) for the selected area ID. **Requires** both a `select.area_id` and a `button.apply_area` on the same `ld6002b` (enforced at compile time); set the values, then press **Apply Area** to send them. A minimum above its matching maximum is rejected with a warning instead of being written.

*See also: [LD6002B 3D Presence Radar](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld6002b#configuration-variables)*

hold_delay.docs:
**range `0`–`65535` s**: Presence hold time, in seconds (default 30 s in the 2025 protocol spec). All options from [Number](https://esphome.io/components/number#config-number).

*See also: [LD6002B 3D Presence Radar](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld6002b#configuration-variables)*

ld6002b_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID of the LD6002B component.

*See also: [LD6002B 3D Presence Radar](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld6002b#configuration-variables)*

low_power_sleep_time.docs:
**range `0`–`60000` ms**: Low power sleep time in milliseconds (default 500 ms). When low-power mode is enabled and the area is unattended, the module sleeps for this interval between scans; higher values reduce idle power but increase detection latency. All options from [Number](https://esphome.io/components/number#config-number).

*See also: [LD6002B 3D Presence Radar](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld6002b#configuration-variables)*

area_id.docs:
Area to edit with `area_config`. Options are `interference_area_0` through `interference_area_3` and `detection_area_0` through `detection_area_3` (mapped internally to IDs 0–7). All options from [Select](https://esphome.io/components/select#config-select).

*See also: [LD6002B 3D Presence Radar](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld6002b#configuration-variables)*

installation_mode.docs:
`top` or `side`. All options from [Select](https://esphome.io/components/select#config-select).

*See also: [LD6002B 3D Presence Radar](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld6002b#configuration-variables)*

ld6002b_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID of the LD6002B component.

*See also: [LD6002B 3D Presence Radar](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld6002b#configuration-variables)*

sensitivity.docs:
`low`, `medium`, or `high`. `low` only detects motion. All options from [Select](https://esphome.io/components/select#config-select).

*See also: [LD6002B 3D Presence Radar](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld6002b#configuration-variables)*

trigger_speed.docs:
`fast` (~0.5 s), `medium` (~1 s), or `slow` (~5 s), the time from detecting a person to triggering. All options from [Select](https://esphome.io/components/select#config-select).

*See also: [LD6002B 3D Presence Radar](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld6002b#configuration-variables)*

ld6002b_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID of the LD6002B component.

*See also: [LD6002B 3D Presence Radar](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld6002b#configuration-variables)*

point_count.docs:
**int**: Total number of point-cloud points reported by the radar. All options from [Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor).

*See also: [LD6002B 3D Presence Radar](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld6002b#configuration-variables)*

target_count.docs:
**int**: Total number of targets currently detected (0 to 3). All options from [Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor).

*See also: [LD6002B 3D Presence Radar](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld6002b#configuration-variables)*

ld6002b_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID of the LD6002B component.

*See also: [LD6002B 3D Presence Radar](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld6002b#configuration-variables)*

low_power.docs:
Enable or disable low power mode. In low power mode, the module uses a lower duty cycle when the area is empty and returns to full tracking on motion. The module documentation reports ~2.5 mA average current in low power idle and ~135 mA in normal tracking. All options from [Switch](https://esphome.io/components/switch#config-switch).

*See also: [LD6002B 3D Presence Radar](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld6002b#configuration-variables)*

point_cloud.docs:
Enable or disable point-cloud reporting, which is what `point_count` reads. All options from [Switch](https://esphome.io/components/switch#config-switch).

*See also: [LD6002B 3D Presence Radar](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld6002b#configuration-variables)*

target_display.docs:
Enable or disable target reporting (`0x0A04`). If disabled, target sensors will show `unknown` and target presence binary sensors turn off until re-enabled. All options from [Switch](https://esphome.io/components/switch#config-switch).

*See also: [LD6002B 3D Presence Radar](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld6002b#configuration-variables)*

ld6002b_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID of the LD6002B component.

*See also: [LD6002B 3D Presence Radar](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld6002b#configuration-variables)*

ota_version.docs:
Firmware version string, if supported by your module firmware. All options from [Text Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/text_sensor#config-text_sensor).

*See also: [LD6002B 3D Presence Radar](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld6002b#configuration-variables)*

work_mode.docs:
`normal` or `low_power` based on the radar work mode. All options from [Text Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/text_sensor#config-text_sensor).

*See also: [LD6002B 3D Presence Radar](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld6002b#configuration-variables)*
